Dining at Mua is a wonderful and tasteful experience
Sep 2026 • Couples
Fantastic meal at Mua. We were dragged along by friends and had no idea where we were going. 
We had already provided our allergies and preferences in advance, and on site it turned out that the dinner is a 15-course menu served in 5 courses. Everything we had indicated was taken into account. Very nice and very tasty. 
We had the matching drink arrangement included and everything together it was a fantastic experience. Everything is local, from one's own garden, or from specific regions in Vietnam where the products are produced in a special way. 
We ate special dishes that we probably wouldn't have chosen ourselves because we didn't know them, but which were all very tasty. 
Besides the food itself, the staff is also extremely hospitable, a top experience all around. 
Highly recommended.

Degustation with Vietnamese twist
Jul 2026 • Couples
We visited after seeing a recent recommendation on Instagram. We chose the set menu with beverage pairings. From start to finish the food was incredible! My husband and I are somewhat foodies and we have dined at some very nice restaurants and this was up there with one of the best meals we have had. 
Also the price is incredible value for the amount of food! 
The restaurant does a Vietnamese take on a degustation style menu and every dish was beautifully prepared and presented and tasted amazing. They use local ingredients from the area which made it more special. Our waiter was enthusiastic and passionate about the food which showed. 
We loved the main dishes the most. The duck was so juicy and tender. The taste was amazing. Served with rice, traditional broth and two salads. So much flavour!
Definitely one of our favourite meals of our visit to Vietnam!! We’d love to visit again. Thank you.

Apr 2026 • Couples
We had an incredibly memorable experience at MÙA — easily one of the highlights of our trip.

The 14-course menu was beautifully curated, with each dish thoughtfully balanced and purposeful. Every course felt intentional, showcasing local and seasonal ingredients in a really refined way.

We opted to share the drink pairing, and it was fantastic — each pairing complemented the dishes perfectly and added another layer to the overall experience.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate. They took the time to walk us through each course, which really helped us appreciate the story and detail behind the food.

A 5/5 experience — we highly recommend this if you’re visiting Hoi An.

Mua is an exceptional dining experience
Dec 2025 • Friends
I have travelled to Hoi An on many occasions, but this was my first experience at Mua, and what an experience it was. The location is spectacular, and takes you right into the heart of the natural beauty of the Hoi An Countryside. 
Uyen and her talented team have taken Vietnamese cuisine, already some of the best in the world and elevated to an exceptional level.
The 14-course tasting menu, using locally grown and seasonal produce, takes you on an incredible culinary journey from start to finish. Every course is thoughtful, well presented, and tastes incredible, and showcases Vietnamese cuisine at the very highest level
To complement the food, Uyen has also carefully selected wine pairings for each course, and they match perfectly, enhancing every dish and making the overall experience even more memorable.
This is without doubt one of the best dining experiences I have had in Vietnam, I cannot recommend Mua highly enough, it is an absolute must visit for anyone travelling to Hoi An, especially if you are a true food lover

2025 Christmas Dinner
Dec 2025 • Family
We went to Mūa for dinner on Christmas Day 2025.
Its only a short Grab ride from Hoi An Ancient Town.
There were 8 of us.
The setting was beautiful, very quiet, and away from the hustle and bustle of Hoi An.
Our pre-dinner cocktails were brilliant.
We all went for the drinks package (wines and sake flight) which were excellent.
The food was beautifully presented and very tasty.
The owner/chef (Tru) introduced himself to our table during the evening, and explained some of his creations - this was a great touch.
The staff were friendly, efficient, and very attentive.
I highly recommend Mūa to future diners.
